Metabolism is determined by the body's energy expenditure, which is set mainly by basal metabolic rate (roughly 60–70% of the total), plus physical activity and the thermic effect of food. Basal rate is driven largely by lean body mass and organ tissue, which are shaped by genetics, age, sex, and body size. The question is cut off, so this assumes you meant "what determines metabolism" in general.
